description: This file defines the `FeatureCreatedStrategy` class, which handles the `FeatureCreated` event in the context of Eclipse Ditto's thing persistence strategies. It extends an abstract class to process the event and modify the `ThingBuilder` object accordingly.

classes.name: FeatureCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles `FeatureCreated` events to update `ThingBuilder` instances by setting features based on the event data.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply a `FeatureCreated` event to a `ThingBuilder.FromCopy`, setting the feature from the event into the builder.
